component.name: Discord Parcel
component.summary: Send and restore files via Discord

description.p: Discord Parcel splits files into numbered parts and uploads them to a Discord channel using your bot. Share a transfer file or message link so the recipient can download the parts and restore the original file.

ul.li: Transfer files without transcoding or changing their contents
Verify restored files with SHA-256 checksums
Protect file contents with optional passphrase encryption

description.p: Discord Parcel is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Discord.

screenshot.caption: Split and send files to a Discord channel
Download and restore a shared file
